verbose.description: Enable verbose mode to display FTP server responses and transfer statistics.

passive.description: Enable passive mode transfer (PASV) for connections behind firewalls.

no_prompt.description: Turns off interactive prompting during multiple file transfers (mget/mput/mdelete).

no_glob.description: Disables filename globbing (wildcard expansion) for file transfer commands.

no_edit.description: Disables command line editing in the ftp interactive shell.

no_login.description: Restrains ftp from attempting auto-login via .netrc upon initial connection.

default_type.description: Default file transfer type (ascii or binary/image).

cr_stripping.description: Toggle carriage return stripping during ASCII type file retrieval.

remote_umask.description: Set the default umask on the remote server for uploaded files (octal value).

idle_timeout.description: Set the inactivity timer on the remote server in seconds (0 to keep current).

ntrans.description: Set or unset filename character translation mechanism (format: inchars,outchars).

nmap.description: Set or unset filename mapping mechanism (format: inpattern,outpattern).
